description: Answer key for `ripr pilot`'s top recommendations: five small Rust crates pinned to exact commits, each with the outcome of every viable cargo-mutants mutant at that commit. `cargo xtask pilot-ranking score` runs pilot on each checkout and judges its top picks against these labels, so ranking changes are measured without rerunning cargo-mutants.
label_rule: Labels are cargo-mutants outcomes (caught or missed) for every viable mutant at the pinned revision, taken from one full run per crate with the recorded cargo-mutants version and arguments. Timeouts and unviable mutants are counted but not labeled. A label belongs to a mutant location, not to a ripr seam, so any seam pilot ranks can be judged without relabeling.
limits: labels speak for the pinned revisions and the recorded cargo-mutants version only
a missed mutant shows the crate's tests did not notice that one change; it is not a suite adequacy measure
the judge's line and owner tiers are coarser than its seam tier; the receipt counts them separately
fetching is opt-in network (--allow-network); checkouts live under target/ and no repository is vendored
